standard: PCAF (2025). Global GHG Accounting and Reporting Standard Part A: Financed Emissions. Third Edition.
note: One record per sovereign. Scope 1 is domestic territorial (production) emissions and is held both including and excluding LULUCF, because §5.9 requires both (p.141) and because the LULUCF term can distort the trend of the energy and industrial sectors. The attribution denominator is PPP-adjusted GDP (p.144), not equity plus debt. Every figure carries its own source and vintage. Singapore and Hong Kong carry the figures from the standard's own worked example (Table 10.3-2, p.202), which gives scope 1 excluding LULUCF only — the including-LULUCF figure is reported absent with the reason rather than invented. Sri Lanka is shipped provisional: order-of-magnitude figures pending a released baseline, and every provisional figure says so. A released dataset replaces this one entirely and is never merged with it.

sources.scope1: Domestic (territorial) emissions including / excluding LULUCF — UNFCCC (di.unfccc.int, Annex I and non-Annex I parties); Climate Watch (climatewatchdata.org); EDGAR (europa.eu, GHG 1970-2018, a 4-year lag). PCAF Table 10.3-4 (pp.205-206).
sources.scope2: Imported grid electricity, steam, heat and cooling — OECD, Carbon dioxide emissions embodied in international trade (CO2 only, industry code D35, 4-year lag). PCAF Table 10.3-4 (p.206).
sources.scope3: Non-energy imports — OECD, Carbon dioxide emissions embodied in international trade (CO2 only, 4-year lag). PCAF Table 10.3-4 (p.206).
sources.pppGdp: GDP, PPP (current international $) — World Bank (worldbank.org). PCAF Table 10.3-4 (p.206).
sources.population: Standard macro-economic metrics — World Bank / IMF. PCAF Table 10.3-4 (p.206).

LK.name: Sri Lanka
LK.gap: Provisional: figures quoted from a description of Sri Lanka's Third National Communication (2010 inventory), not read from it, and superseded by the First Biennial Transparency Report (Dec 2024, inventory 2011–2021) which has not yet been opened. Re-read both and the World Bank PPP-GDP series (with the retrieval date) before any figure is disclosed; state option 1b, score 2, until a technical expert review report supports 1a.

exclLULUCF.source: Third National Communication of Sri Lanka (1 Dec 2022), 2010 inventory: total excluding LULUCF 22,084.62 Gg CO2e (energy 14,154.16 · IPPU 448.57 · agriculture 6,505.67 · waste 976.22). Verification: secondary_reported. https://unfccc.int/sites/default/files/resource/Third%20National%20Communication%20of%20Sri%20Lanka.pdf. EDGAR 2024 report gives 22 MtCO2e for 2023 on the same boundary.

inclLULUCF.source: Third National Communication, 2010: LULUCF gross emissions 21,460.13 Gg and removals −39,826.3 Gg, a net sink of 18,366 Gg; net total including LULUCF 3,718.45 Gg CO2e (43,544.75 − 39,826.3). Verification: secondary_reported (derived from quoted figures). The earlier provisional row carried the LULUCF term with the wrong sign.

pppGdp.source: World Bank, GDP PPP (current international $), Sri Lanka, 2020 — approximate.
